prose: For those who like to hear me on the guest side of the podcast dynamic, here's a great flow state I found with Dan on the Cosmic Keys Podcast. In this talk, I expose the archetypal origins of the digital identity, and why commodification and identification with an artificial self is spiritual suicide. Full of etymological word magic breakdowns, the most important word we define, witness, and champion is Truth.

To hear the extended version of the episode that is reserved for Dan's patrons, sign up for Cosmic Keys' Patreon. On CK you will get adept astrology updates and eye opening esoteric conversations, so I highly recommend you subscribe.
